url.description: The primary URL to scan for CMS identification.

input_file.description: File with URLs, one per line. Use '-' to read from stdin.

output_file.description: File to dump results into (JSON). Use '-' to print to stdout.

threads.description: Number of threads to use for concurrent requests.

proxy.description: Proxy server address to tunnel through (format: localhost:8080).

user_agent.description: User-Agent header string to use in requests.

verbosity.description: Verbosity level. Increase for more detailed output.

n_stop_after.description: Stop after this amount of CMSs have been detected.

a_all.description: If true, do not stop after the first CMS is detected.

m_harder.description: If true, try harder to find a match without making more requests.

d_no_subdomains.description: If true, disable the search for subdomains.

no_cache_load.description: If true, do not load cached responses.

no_cache_save.description: If true, do not save the cache for later use.

quiet.description: If true, set wig to not prompt for user input during run.
